description: How a report-as-diagram plate is made: family, spec, v1's assembly order, 4K render behind a gate, tiled vision check, leak scan, appendix.

phases.phase_description: Families chosen from the dossier's spine and tables; registers refused when tables exist.
Title, cells, currents, axes and legend written from the analysis, verbatim where anchored.
v1's order: frame, spine, currents, branches, labels, legend.
Behind a render gate (one at a time on the current plan).

phases.phase_name: Tiled vision check and leak scan
phases.phase_description: Each tile read for compliance and text leaks; one revision.
Plates appended to the dossier with their specs.

output_description: 4K plates with compliance records, shown on the desk's plates page.
